name: Nippon Aqua Co.,Ltd.
summary: Nippon Aqua Co., Ltd. is a Japanese maker and distributor of energy-saving building materials. Its products are AQUA FOAM, a polyurethane foam insulation sprayed on site, along with heat-blocking sheets, spacers and AQUA FOAM NEO items. They are used in individual homes as well as larger commercial and public buildings. The company dates from 2004.
